title.id: Pratinjau berbagi situs dokumen tampil baru dan makin informatif
title.en: The documentation site social preview gets a fresh, more informative look

body.id: Saat tautan portal dokumentasi Pasak dibagikan di grup chat atau jejaring sosial, kini tampil kartu pratinjau baru bergaya khas Pasak: judul tegas, ringkasan isi panduan, serta tanda-tanda fitur unggulan — pemberitaan tautan jadi lebih menarik dan mudah dikenali.
body.en: When a Pasak documentation portal link is shared in chats or on social networks, it now shows a new preview card in Pasak's signature style: a bold headline, a guide summary, and markers of standout features — link sharing becomes more attractive and instantly recognizable.

items.id: Kartu pratinjau dibarui dengan tata letak baru: identitas di atas, judul besar di tengah, serta tanda-tanda fitur unggulan di bawah.
items.en: The preview card was redesigned with a new layout: identity on top, a large headline at center, and feature markers at the bottom.

items.id: Cap fitur unggulan kini jelas dan tidak lagi menutupi teks — semua butir terbaca penuh di ukuran berapa pun.
items.en: Standout feature markers are now clear and no longer clip their labels — every item reads fully at any size.

items.id: Keterangan gambar pratinjau untuk layanan berbagi (Open Graph & Twitter/X) diperkaya sehingga pembaca kartu paham isinya sebelum mengklik.
items.en: Preview image captions for sharing services (Open Graph & Twitter/X) were enriched so readers understand the content before clicking.
